description: This file contains utility functions for handling 'Bubble' nodes within a Lexical-based editor. It includes functions to convert DOM elements into BubbleNodes, create new BubbleNodes, and type guards for BubbleNodes.

classes.name: BubbleNode
classes.description: A class representing a Bubble node within the editor, used for custom node handling.

methods.name: convertToBubbleElement
methods.description: Converts a DOM div element with certain data attributes into a Lexical DOMConversionOutput containing a BubbleNode.

methods.name: $createBubbleNode
methods.description: Factory function to create a new BubbleNode instance given its UUID.

methods.name: $isBubbleNode
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a given node is an instance of BubbleNode.
